start.name: Desert dune
start.description: A dune, a starry sky and the outlines of a city.

city.name: City entrance
city.description: The city main entrance. Two night guards are on duty.

square.name: City square
square.description: The city square. Weird shops and even weirder people

bar.name: Afterlife bar
bar.description: A strange looking night-bar with loud music.

shop.name: Spice shop
shop.description: Shelves lined with colorful spice jars

camp.name: Nomad camp
camp.description: The space-nomads camp. It's barren and desolated

nest.name: Hunter nest
nest.description: The nest of the famous twin-suns hunter.

door.name: Giant door
door.description: An ominous gigantic alien door carved in the mountain and covered with ancient symbols. A keyhole shaped like no key you own sits at its center.

suburbs.name: City suburbs
suburbs.description: The city suburbs. You can hear barking.

spice.name: Blue spice
spice.description: A tasty spice that re-architectures your brain chemistry.

liquor.name: Space liquor
liquor.description: An alien liquor. The smell is strong and transmundane

key.name: Alien key
key.description: A strange alien key with ancient symbols on it.

bone.name: Extraterrestrial bone
bone.description: A bone, not like any bone you ever seen

water.name: Flask of water
water.description: A sealed flask, heavy with the only currency that matters out here.

crysknife.name: Bone crysknife
crysknife.description: A milky blade ground from a tooth. It hums faintly when you hold it.

guard.name: City Guard
guard.description: A stern-looking guard watching over the city.
dialogue: Watch yourself and everything will be ok traveler.

barman.name: Tavern keeper
barman.description: A space-barman with small blue eyes.

vendor.name: Spice reseller
vendor.description: A mysterious spice merchant with a piercing gaze.

hunter.name: Twin suns hunter
hunter.description: A space-nomad hunter with a long rifle.

dog.name: Stray dog
dog.description: A stray desert dog. He appears friendly

dialogue.offer: There is a stray out in the suburbs that howls all night and empties my bar. Take this bone and go make a friend of him.
dialogue.active: Still carrying that bone? The suburbs are north of the dune, traveler.
dialogue.complete: Wuf ! (The dog buries the bone in the sand, digs once more, and nudges something pale towards your boot.)

dialogue.offer: The twin-suns hunter has been taxing my caravans from his nest north of the camp. End that, and I will pay you the only way worth being paid.
dialogue.active: The hunter still breathes, and my caravans still pay him. Come back when that has changed.
dialogue.complete: The dunes are quieter already. Here, drawn from my own cistern. He carried something of the mountain on him too, I hear.
